author: Khan Academy
description:
Electric charge is a scalar quantity and is described as positive or negative. Coulomb’s law describes the electrostatic force between two charged objects as directly proportional to the magnitude of each of the charges and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between the objects. The direction of the electrostatic force depends on the signs of the charges of the interacting objects and is along the line of separation between the objects. Free space has a constant value of electric permittivity that appears in physical relationships.
